summary.text: Jessica Henderson is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 90, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Amaad Rivera-Wagner.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Henderson won the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 90 in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024, general election to Amaad Rivera-Wagner, 52.5% to 47.4%.
She advanced from the Republican primary for the same seat on August 11, 2026, and faces Rivera-Wagner again in the general election.
